critique.evidence: The injection switch passed keyboard traversal, accessible naming, visible-focus, touch-target, viewport-overflow, and reduced-motion checks at all three viewports. The section has no automated violations, but its WCAG contrast result remains incomplete and serious for 14 nodes across every viewport, including red/cyan text and badges over gradients or overlapping layers. Header contrast is likewise unverified on tablet/mobile, and no screen-reader or switch state-announcement evidence was supplied. These missing proofs prevent an 8.
critique.fix: Replace translucent/gradient text backdrops with deterministic solid colors where needed, measure every flagged foreground/background pair against WCAG AA, and rerun axe until contrast has neither violations nor incomplete nodes. Add assistive-technology evidence that the switch announces its name, role, state change, and revealed content; also measure header touch targets and contrast at tablet/mobile widths.
